name: Alkimiya SilicaPools collateralizedMint cast bug
verdict_reason: Yoink's tx 0x9b9a6dd0 (block 22146340, position 0) replays the original attacker's victim calls: same Morpho 10 WBTC flashLoan, same 7 SilicaPools calls (collateralizedMint, 2x safeTransferFrom, startPool, endPool, redeemShort) and the same attacker-deployed fake-index contract 0x9188738a; only the caller contract address (attacker contract -> Yoink contract) and the block-timestamp parameters (0x67e6c18b in the attacker's simulation at 22146339 state vs 0x67e6c197 in Yoink's block) differ, plus derived ERC1155 id. The original attacker EOA 0xf6ffba5c deployed the helper contracts (22146328, 22146335) and configured them (22146338) before; its own attack tx 0xc8875004 landed one block LATER (22146341, index 275) and reverted. A debug_traceCall of the attacker tx at 22146339 state succeeds with net +1.14015390 WBTC = exactly Yoink's 114,015,390 sat. Not in mempool-dumpster so pre-emption of a PUBLIC pending tx is unproven (first-seen UNKNOWN). Note: DeFiHackLabs header does list Yoink as 'MEV frontrunner' and 0xF6ff.. as original attacker, but its Attack Contract/Tx fields are Yoink's; Verichains/Olympix attribute Yoink's tx/contract to the attack.

replay_evidence.summary: Call-for-call copy of the attacker's call tree, minus view calls, executed from Yoink's contract; adds a UniV3 WBTC->WETH swap, WETH.withdraw and coinbase payment. Same fake index contract 0x9188738a (attacker-deployed) is used as the pool 'index' and Yoink also calls its 2ee79ded.
replay_evidence.decoded_with: research/bot-re/analysis.md grammar: selector 9846cd9e | x=0 | f=0 | nStores=1 (key f23a6e61 = onERC1155Received, ret f23a6e61..) | ops: CALL WBTC.approve(pool,max); CALL WBTC.approve(Morpho,max); CALL Morpho.flashLoan(WBTC,1e9, 1600-byte callback script: 0xcb header + 8 CALLs); op3 SWAP (UniV3 pool 0x4585fe77, WBTC, a=0,b=0) [name inferred]; value 999 => per-mille bribe 99.9%
replay_evidence.attacker_equivalent_calls: attacker contract 0x69af47f3 under attack(): Morpho.flashLoan(10 WBTC) -> callback 0x31f57072: WBTC.transfer(pool,56,125,794), approve, collateralizedMint, safeTransferFrom x2, index.2ee79ded, startPool, endPool, redeemShort, approve(Morpho)
replay_evidence.differing_words: mint/start/end/redeem: startTime & endTime words 0x67e6c18b (attacker sim, block 22146339) vs 0x67e6c197 (Yoink block ts 1743176087); safeTransferFrom tokenId word differs (derived from pool params hash); caller contract address normalised
replay_evidence.counterfactual: debug_traceCall of attacker tx (0xf6ffba5c -> 0x69af47f3, 0x36eeed3f) on state after block 22146339: success, net +114,015,390 sat WBTC; on state after 22146340: reverts (WBTC transferFrom inside collateralizedMint) - raw site/raw/rpc/alk_simA_22146339.json, alk_simA_22146340.json
replay_evidence.how_yoink_saw_it: UNKNOWN. Attacker txs 0xbf757045 / 0xc8875004 are not in mempool-dumpster (private flow or missed; dumpster saw only ~50% of block 22146341 txs). Yoink had 22146328 (index deploy) and 22146335/22146338 (attack contract + config) on-chain before its block.
